prerequisites.name: Bun and application dependencies
prerequisites.reason: Run the existing Hono/Better Auth web application
prerequisites.verificationCommand: bun -e 'import {Hono} from "hono"; import {auth} from "./src/auth/index.ts"; const a=new Hono().get("/probe",c=>c.text("ok")); if((await a.request("http://localhost/probe")).status!==200)process.exit(1); if(await auth.api.getSession({headers:new Headers()}))process.exit(1); process.exit(0);'

prerequisites.name: Node and SQLite native binding
prerequisites.reason: Execute the repository's Drizzle SQLite runner

prerequisites.name: Drizzle migration tooling
prerequisites.reason: Apply actual journalled migrations rather than substitute SQL execution
prerequisites.verificationCommand: d=$(mktemp -d /data/tmp/venture-prereq.XXXXXX) && DATABASE_DRIVER=sqlite DATABASE_URL="$d/probe.db" bun run db:migrate >/dev/null; s=$?; test -z "$d" || rm -rf "$d"; exit "$s"

prerequisites.name: Local PostgreSQL service and venture schema
prerequisites.reason: Verify supported PostgreSQL persistence, authenticated connectivity and disposable test-database capability
prerequisites.verificationCommand: bun -e 'import {Pool} from "pg";import {env} from "./src/config/env.ts";const p=new Pool({connectionString:env.POSTGRES_URL,connectionTimeoutMillis:5000});try{await p.query("SELECT count(*) FROM venture_conversation");const n="venture_prereq_"+crypto.randomUUID().replaceAll("-","");await p.query("CREATE DATABASE "+n);await p.query("DROP DATABASE "+n)}finally{await p.end()}'

prerequisites.name: TypeScript compiler
prerequisites.reason: Compile the existing TypeScript stack without dependency upgrades

prerequisites.name: Chromium and Playwright
prerequisites.reason: Verify real responsive rendering, keyboard interaction and session resume
prerequisites.verificationCommand: bun -e 'import {chromium} from "playwright-core";const b=await chromium.launch({executablePath:process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH||"/usr/bin/chromium",headless:true,args:["--no-sandbox","--disable-dev-shm-usage"]});try{const p=await b.newPage();await p.setContent("<main>probe</main>");if(await p.locator("main").textContent()!=="probe")throw Error("browser unavailable")}finally{await b.close()}'
